text: I don't always spell quite right when I haven't a dictionary, and nobody tells me.” “It will do,” answered the Earl. “Higgins will not complain of the spelling. I'm not the philanthropist; you are. Dip your pen in the ink.” Fauntleroy took up the pen and dipped it in the ink-bottle, then he arranged himself in position, leaning on the table. “Now,” he inquired, “what must I say?” “You may say, 'Higgins is not to be interfered with, for the present,' and sign it, 'Fauntleroy,'” said the Earl.
